title: Бунт запертого Шефа  (The Locked-Up Chef's Rampage)

segments.t: Trapped inside the cold storage room, Chef Barinov roars that he has an urgent date to get to and threatens to destroy Senya and Fedya the second he gets out. Hearing his furious shouting, the cooks are more convinced than ever that the fugu poison has made him delirious.
Лучше будет, если вы будете сзади!
Иначе я выйду и убью вас!
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
'Believe me, it will be better this way!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'believe!' before landing on 'better'.
Лучше будет, если вы будете сзади!
'It will be better if you stay in the back!' Senya pairs 'better' with 'behind, leaning back' directly, since spoken Russian skips English filler words like 'the', 'a', and 'is'.
Иначе я выйду и убью вас!
'Otherwise I will come out and kill all of you!' Chef Viktor chooses the respectful plural 'you' alongside 'you' to keep a polite distance.
'Chef, you are not in your right mind!' Senya anchors the line on 'chef', while 'inappropriate' completes the thought.
'I am completely in my right mind!' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'reasonable' without extra filler words. Senya answers right away.
'I need to go on a date!' The grammar packs 'for me' and 'date' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Torture, Chef!' The grammar packs 'attempt' and 'chef' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'I will show you torture!' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'attempt' in spoken Russian. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'I am going to kill Senya, damn it!' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'host' without extra filler words.
'I want to kill Senya!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'Senya'.
'What? Huh?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'what' and finishing on 'and'. Senya answers right away.
'Huh? What?' The meaning hinges on 'and' working together with 'and' in spoken Russian.
'Huh? You scoundrels?' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'and', while 'scumbags' completes the thought. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Лучше будет, если вы будете сзади!
Иначе я выйду и убью вас!

That wraps up this scene as furious at missing his date with Elena, Chef Barinov pounds on the door and threatens to kill Senya and Fedya while the cooks remain convinced he is delirious. Until next time!
